subject: Environmental Studies
stem: Electricity generated at a power plant is increased to very high voltage before being sent over long-distance transmission lines (to reduce energy loss), and then reduced to a safe, usable voltage before reaching homes. The device that changes (raises or lowers) AC voltage in this way is the:
explanation: A transformer changes AC voltage levels using electromagnetic induction — a step-up transformer raises voltage (used before transmission to reduce power loss), and a step-down transformer lowers it (before household use) — distinct from a generator (produces electricity) or a rectifier (converts AC to DC).
